specs.label: Theme switcher ▸ open dropdown
specs.note: The shell-header ThemeToggle trigger (data-testid=theme-toggle) opens a Radix dropdown listing the UI themes. Opening it renders the dropdown content with the 'UI theme' label and the two options.

specs.label: Appearance toggle (dark ⇄ light)
specs.note: In the modern theme the header shows a Sun/Moon appearance toggle (data-testid=appearance-toggle) that flips data-appearance on <html>. Playwright boots with prefers-color-scheme:light, so the resolved initial appearance is light and one click flips it to dark. needsVisual so a human confirms the light/dark flip regardless of the environment's default.

specs.label: Theme switcher ▸ Classic — PyMOL
specs.note: Selecting the 'Classic — PyMOL' checkbox item flips the live look to the classic theme, stamping data-ui-theme=classic on <html> and re-skinning the whole UI without reload.

specs.label: Theme switcher ▸ Modern — shadcn
specs.note: Selecting the 'Modern — shadcn' checkbox item switches back to the modern theme (data-ui-theme=shadcn). Runs after the classic spec, restoring the product default look.

specs.label: External GUI ▸ Ctrl+E toggle dockable
specs.note: The window-level Ctrl+E shortcut (extGuiDock.toggleDockable) floats the External GUI dock and restores its real title bar. From the default docked/no-title-bar state one Ctrl+E yields floating + title bar (data-dock=float, extgui-titlebar visible).

specs.label: External GUI title bar ▸ dock Left (L)
specs.note: The title bar's L button re-docks the External GUI to the left area (setArea 'left'), flipping the panel to the side layout. Runs after the Ctrl+E spec, so the title bar is already showing.

specs.label: External GUI title bar ▸ dock Right (R)
specs.note: The title bar's R button re-docks the External GUI to the right area (setArea 'right').

specs.label: External GUI title bar ▸ dock Bottom (B)
specs.note: The title bar's B button re-docks the External GUI to the bottom area (setArea 'bottom').

specs.label: External GUI title bar ▸ float/dock toggle
specs.note: The title bar's float/dock button calls toggleDockable. From the docked-with-title-bar state it returns to docked-without-title-bar, so the title bar disappears — the observable effect. Runs after the dock.bottom spec.

specs.label: External GUI ▸ double-click gives title bar without floating
specs.note: LIMITATION: ExtGuiFrame.mouseDoubleClickEvent -> toggleDockable(neverFloat=true) adds a title bar without detaching. The audit action DSL has no double-click primitive (only single click), so this affordance cannot be driven deterministically. Recorded with a single click on the panel body and a page-error guard; needsVisual for a human to exercise the real double-click.

specs.label: internal_gui_width gutter ▸ drag-resize / double-click collapse
specs.note: LIMITATION: the vertical splitter (data-testid=gutter) resizes the right-hand internal-GUI column on pointer drag and collapses it on double-click (gutterClick/gutterDrag). The audit DSL has no pointer-drag or double-click primitive, so a bare click cannot move the width. Recorded with a click and error guards; needsVisual for a human to drag it. The gutter's presence is asserted so a missing splitter is still caught.

specs.label: External GUI height splitter ▸ drag-resize
specs.note: LIMITATION: the horizontal splitter (.splitter--h) below the bottom-docked External GUI resizes its height on pointer drag (dragConsole). No drag primitive exists in the audit DSL, so a click cannot move it. Recorded with a click and error guards; needsVisual for a human to drag it. Present only while the dock is at the bottom (the default and the state left by the float toggle spec).

specs.label: External GUI title bar ▸ Visible (×) close
specs.note: The title bar's × button (toggleVisible) hides the whole External GUI dock. Setup presses Ctrl+E to reveal the title bar first; clicking × removes the extgui element from the layout.

specs.label: Header ▸ ext gui toggle (show)
specs.note: The shell-header 'ext gui' button (data-testid=extgui-visible) is Display ▸ External GUI ▸ Visible. Runs after the close spec left the dock hidden, so this click re-shows it — verifying the show direction of the toggle.

specs.label: Header ▸ ext gui toggle (hide)
specs.note: The same header 'ext gui' button hiding the dock — runs after the show spec (dock visible), so this click hides it, verifying the hide direction. Placed last because it removes the command line the other specs depend on.
